body.x: OTITON Medical Co., Ltd. (CEO Jayden Kim) participated in CES 2026, the world’s largest IT and technology exhibition, held in Las Vegas, the United States, from January 6 to 9 (local time), and took part in an interview at the AVING Media Stage inside the Seoul Pavilion during the exhibition period.
Founded in 2022, OTITON Medical is a Korean healthcare startup that has achieved rapid growth by developing both home-use smart medical devices and healthcare platforms.

Through its flagship brand “Dr. in Home,” the company has introduced medical solutions for everyday use, including thermometers and diagnostic devices. In particular, by integrating AI-based analysis technologies into its platform, OTITON Medical provides a home healthcare environment that enables individuals and families to manage their health with ease.

A representative example is the company’s smart thermometer, previously launched on the market. Going beyond simple temperature measurement, the device incorporates AI that can diagnose ear-related conditions, such as otitis media. Using a built-in camera and a dedicated application, users can capture and analyze images of the ear, with the system indicating the presence of inflammation. The marketability and competitiveness of this technology were demonstrated last year when it received a CES Innovation Award.

Continuing its participation from last year, OTITON Medical once again took part in CES 2026 and drew global attention by producing another Innovation Award–winning product. The solution behind the company’s second consecutive award is a “Pet Smart Thermometer” that extends ear disease diagnostic technology to companion animals. The product was recognized for its value in reducing dependence on veterinary clinics and enabling pet owners to respond early to inflammatory conditions.

Designed to suit the physical characteristics of companion animals such as dogs and cats, Pet Smart Thermometer integrates temperature monitoring and visual tracking of ear health into a compact form factor. Without complex operation, it allows pet owners to easily check key health indicators in daily life, helping them identify early signs of illness.

In addition, the device connects to OTITON Medical’s new platform, “Dr. Pet Care,” which supports real-time endoscopic image viewing and health data recording. According to the company, the accumulated data enables more objective and reliable medical consultations when visiting veterinary clinics.

Building on this CES appearance, OTITON Medical plans to raise awareness of the Dr. in Home platform, launched at the end of last year, and accelerate global sales. The company also aims to officially commercialize Dr. Pet Care within the year, establishing a home healthcare pipeline that encompasses both people and companion animals.

Jayden Kim, CEO of OTITON Medical, said, “This CES served as an important stage to accelerate OTITON Medical’s leap into the global market.” He added, “If last year was about starting to make our company and brand known both domestically and internationally, this year we plan to pursue practical and aggressive market expansion based on the results gained at the exhibition.”

Kim continued, “To that end, OTITON Medical will continue to accumulate medical data, further advance its AI models, and actively expand overseas partnerships to build a more reliable healthcare platform,” adding, “We will continue to innovate so that consumers can manage their health more safely and conveniently in everyday life.”

The company participated in CES 2026, held from January 6 to 9, as part of the Seoul Pavilion located in Eureka Park, the startup-focused exhibition area. The Seoul Pavilion at CES 2026 supported a total of 70 startups with participation from 19 startup support organizations based in Seoul, including the Seoul Business Agency, district offices, related institutions, and universities. The 70 exhibiting companies were composed of startups offering products and services based on advanced technologies such as AI, mobility, and healthcare. Among them, selected outstanding companies were given the opportunity to participate in CES’s official media event, Unveiled.
